title: Baithak — Ahmedabad
summary: A communal musical evening — original compositions, folk and devotional songs, stories shared in a circle. Everyone welcome, whatever your age or background.
body: Communal musical evenings where we gather to sing, share stories, and connect. The evening moves through original compositions, traditional folk music and devotional pieces. Come whoever you are — the room is open to every age and background. Seats are limited; book ahead.

title: Kabir Sang Ruhdaari 2026
summary: A room of nearly four hundred people singing along while painters worked at the edge of the stage.

title: Baithak — Phag Poonam
summary: The monthly sitting — music, readings and work-in-progress in a small circle. Holi songs for the full moon of Phagun.

title: Kabir Sang Ruhdaari — the first gathering
summary: An earnest attempt to sit, breathe, and have a moment with ourselves, with art, and with the universe.
